PPT template designs and palettes are adapted from:
https://github.com/wuhua2026/ppt-templates
Commit: f0e14a5621764c605d0c5027bfab172ef1d1eb0f
License: MIT (included in LICENSE).

Sources: js/src/generators/cover.ts (SplitScreen, MinimalistGradient,
LayeredDepth) and js/src/themes/index.ts.

EasyPocketMD adapts these designs to its 10-inch layouts and existing editable
content renderer. Title fitting, pagination, readable secondary colors, direct
export and the template selector are maintained here. Templates are bundled;
exports do not depend on downloading assets from an external template site.
